title: Persist contacts and inquiry terms without workflow commands
requirements: Add one Alembic revision for contact_cards, channel_identities, inquiries and inquiry_terms using the accepted names, UUID keys, statuses, source/channel and experience constraints, snapshots, requested-time representation, money bounds and foreign keys.
Enforce one inquiry_terms row per inquiry and the required consistency between selected service option, positive participants, optional positive duration, and nullable agreed totals/prepayment.

Keep current contact fields on the inquiry beside immutable JSONB contact and selection snapshots; do not create endpoints, commands, visits, cash notes, receipts, drafts, authentication or channel adapters.
Extend PostgreSQL integration coverage for identity uniqueness, invalid inquiry/term values, and a legal NEW inquiry with unknown agreed price.
acceptance: A clean database reaches the DB-002 Alembic head, retaining the DB-001 guard/catalog tables.
The integration test proves database rejection for at least one invalid enum, one non-positive participant count, one invalid money value and duplicate channel identity.
No public, owner or bot behavior becomes callable.

shared_paths_approval.reason: The user authorized continued implementation; DB-002 follows the accepted schema after the verified catalog baseline and introduces no externally callable workflow.
